decisions.reason: As a newly launched specialist naval lighting line that matches the firm's engineering and demanding-environment niche, management would likely tolerate initial uncertainty and keep it unless early market response is clearly weak.
The desk lamp is somewhat less central to the firm's systems-oriented direction, but its own product page and ergonomic fit give it enough promise for a large firm with slack to keep it for now.
A general interior luminaire sits close to the firm's core building-lighting business and the 'G2' framing suggests platform continuity, so it is likely to stay on the market.
Because management presents this pendant luminaire as a flagship aligned with its strategic move toward advanced, efficient lighting, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.

The marine HMI searchlight serves a specialist niche the firm knows well, but its narrower market and weaker fit with the LED-oriented direction make it one of the more vulnerable lines if results disappoint.

This marine searchlight remains consistent with the firm's robust specialist-lighting capabilities, and a large established manufacturer would usually keep such a recent line while learning about demand.
